   - Immediately after the update, use `GetSuccessfulRequestVolume` to record traffic volume for comparison.

### Anomaly Monitoring and Rollback Plan

- After updating the minimum TLS version for each app, I will use real-time traffic data to monitor for anomalies and compare traffic before and after the update.  
- If an anomaly is detected (e.g., a dramatic drop in traffic volume), I will notify you, roll back the app to the previous TLS version (1.0), and continue with the plan for the next app.  
- If multiple rollbacks are required, I will abandon the rest of the plan to avoid further disruptions.  

This plan ensures updates happen sequentially, with thorough monitoring and safe rollback procedures in case of problems.
